purpose: 八个独立摊位配色探索；本轮仅方案图片，未接入运行素材

items.name: 朱砂米金
items.brief: Canopy broad stripes: rich cinnabar/vermilion #C84C32 alternating warm oat ivory #F3DDB4. Top rail dark vermilion #9D382C. Lanterns warm ivory paper with amber inner glow, honey-gold ribs and red-brown tassels. Chef apron and straps deep wine red #8D3430. Both stools deep lacquered warm red #A94B38. Plant pot deep glazed jade #4D7465 with understated cream wave motif. Tabletop menu frame wine red, plate warm white with very thin gold rim. Fixed stall wood luminous natural honeywood. Feeling: welcoming Chinese supper stall, vivid and clean, classic red/gold rethought with jade accent.
items.prompt:

Change ONLY the listed colored materials and the stall's wood finish if specified. Main color, secondary neutral and small accents must be balanced: not every object the same hue. Colors should be clear and attractive, never a global color filter or muddy gray. Lighting must not wash all palette colors orange. Same 4:3 landscape composition, fill the canvas, full stall including feet and canopy with a small breathing margin.
